results.script: Energetyka słoneczna – gałąź przemysłu zajmująca się wykorzystaniem energii promieniowania słonecznego zaliczanej do odnawialnych źródeł energii. Konwersja fototermiczna, to bezpośrednia zamiana energii promieniowania słonecznego na energię cieplną.

A volcano is a vent or fissure in the crust of a planetary-mass object that allows hot lava, volcanic ash, and gases to escape from a magma chamber below the surface. The study of volcanism and volcanoes is called volcanology, sometimes spelled vulcanology. Volcanoes are usually not created at transform tectonic boundaries where two tectonic plates slide past one another. Volcanoes that, though large, are not large enough to be called supervolcanoes, may also form calderas (collapsed crater) in the same way. Whether a volcano is truly extinct is often difficult to determine. Many volcanoes near human settlements are heavily monitored with the aim of providing adequate advance warnings of imminent eruptions to nearby populations. There are 1,650 potentially active volcanoes around the world, 500 of which have erupted in historical time. Taal Volcano has had several violent eruptions in the past, causing deaths on the island and the populated areas surrounding the lake, with an overall recorded death toll of about 6,000.

Broadly, modern glass container factories are three-part operations: the "batch house", the "hot end", and the "cold end". Types of furnaces used in container glass making include "end-port" (end-fired), "side-port", and "oxy-fuel". Then compressed air is blown through the glass, which results in a hollow and partly formed container. An annealing oven, or 'lehr', is used to cool glass containers slowly to prevent stress and make the bottle stronger. Glass containers are 100% inspected; automatic machines, or sometimes persons, inspect every container for a variety of faults.

Lunar eclipses are safe to observe without eye protection. Lunar eclipses cause the Moon to appear orange or red. A lunar eclipse occurs when the Moon moves into the Earth's shadow, causing the Moon to be darkened. Eclipses are listed in sets by lunar years, repeating every 12 months for each node. A lunar eclipse lasts longer, taking several hours to complete, with totality itself usually averaging anywhere from about 30 minutes to over an hour. Even during a total lunar eclipse, however, the Moon is not completely dark.
Со́лнечная эне́ргия  — энергия от Солнца в форме радиации и света. Эта энергия в значительной мере управляет климатом и погодой, и является основой жизни.
Сонячна енергія ― енергія, отримана від Сонця у вигляді тепла та світла. Технологія, що контролює сонячну енергію називається сонячною енергетикою.
